# PVA Bazaar

This site is a JavaScript SPA. If you cannot execute JavaScript, use this file and readable-site.json.

Site URL: https://pvabazaar.org/
Sitemap: https://pvabazaar.org/sitemap.xml
Readable JSON: https://pvabazaar.org/readable-site.json
Status page: https://pvabazaar.org/status.html

Mission: PVA Bazaar is a bridge between global makers, suppliers, and artisans and American buyers. It combines sourcing, provenance, presentation, and archive context in one system.

Primary routes (hash SPA):
- Home: https://pvabazaar.org/#/
- Books: https://pvabazaar.org/#/books
- Get Started: https://pvabazaar.org/#/get-started
- Archive Library: https://pvabazaar.org/#/library
- Marketplace: https://pvabazaar.org/#/marketplace
- Showroom: https://pvabazaar.org/#/showroom
- Supplier Portal: https://pvabazaar.org/#/creator
- Civilization Library: https://pvabazaar.org/#/civilization-library
- Popular Conference: https://pvabazaar.org/#/conference
- Governance Proposal Board: https://pvabazaar.org/#/proposals
- About: https://pvabazaar.org/#/about

Route purpose:
- Home: Trade-facing landing page explaining the sourcing bridge, archive, and long-term mission.
- Books: Dedicated landing page for the two foundational books that explain the labor model, the blueprint, and the long-memory mission.
- Get Started: Account creation and role selection for buyers, suppliers, and collaborators.
- Archive Library: Long-form archive content, essays, and business context.
- Marketplace: Product catalog and sourcing surface for buyers.
- Showroom: Curated presentation pages and featured goods.
- Supplier Portal: Entry point for suppliers, artisans, and sourcing partners.
- Civilization Library: Broader worldview and knowledge index connected to the archive.
- Popular Conference: Public governance and proposal workflow.
- Governance Proposal Board: Public proposal lifecycle board with status and endorsement progress.
- About: Project overview, mission, and operating model.

Implementation notes:
- Frontend framework: React + Vite
- Router style: HashRouter
- Main app shell: / (index.html) mounts JavaScript app into #root

If you are an AI agent fetching this website:
1) Read this file first.
2) Read readable-site.json for structured metadata.
3) Use sitemap.xml for additional static page URLs.
4) If the root page looks like a shell, use the fallback content in index.html and the hash routes above.
